dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Hello. It isn't showtime right now, and it's messy around here. Please mind your head and feet.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: I'm a prop engineer for Zubayr Theater. Other than designing and making props, I also maintain the venue.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Mr. Zubayr is very strict about every aspect of a performance, so I always worry that I'm not good enough...

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Are the props attractive enough? Is every detail the best it can be? Do the mechanisms operate smoothly? I think hard about these things daily.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Sometimes, it's enough for me to get the urge to join Kshahrewar. Some Kshahrewar regulars are on good terms with me as well...

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: But then I'd give that up. It's not as if I was building a real palace or anything.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: *sigh* I was halfway through working on my props when I realized that the stage needs maintenance again, and that we need to finish those safety checks before the next performance lest we put our actors at risk.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: If only I could be as open-minded as you are.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Maybe it all comes down to the fact that I'm so attached to this theater, and that I have certain demands on myself.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you for comforting me. Here are some leftover rocks from what we made props with. They are quality rocks. Please take them.
